description: Quality gate definitions for Qwen-Harness workflow stages. Each gate specifies pass conditions, failure behavior, and scope.

offline_e2e.name: Offline End-to-End
offline_e2e.description: The full workflow must complete successfully with --offline flag, no network access, and no real API keys.

pass_conditions.description: qwen-harness run --offline completes all stages without network calls
No HTTP requests to external services are made during offline run
No API key environment variables are required for offline execution
pass_conditions.check: all model calls use mock or cached responses

pass_conditions.description: Every stage in the workflow produces a valid output file in stages/<stage>/output.json
pass_conditions.check: all stage output files exist and are valid JSON

offline_e2e.failure_behavior: Block workflow completion; report which condition failed with stage context

hash_consistency.name: Data Hash Consistency
hash_consistency.description: All data files referenced during a run must match their frozen snapshot hashes. Detects mid-run data mutation.

pass_conditions.description: route_catalog.json SHA256 matches the hash recorded at run start
xuhui_routes.geojson SHA256 matches the hash recorded at run start
environment_dashboard.json SHA256 matches the hash recorded at snapshot time
Weights file SHA256 matches the hash recorded in experiment variant config
Skills files SHA256 matches the hash recorded in run manifest
Configuration files SHA256 matches the hash recorded in run manifest

hash_consistency.failure_behavior: Immediately stop the run; record drift details in events.jsonl; suggest creating a new run

on_drift.message_template: Data file '{file}' hash mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}. Data was modified during run. Create a new run or investigate the change.

structured_output.name: Structured Output Validation
structured_output.description: Every stage must produce output conforming to its declared JSON Schema. Free-text responses are never accepted.

pass_conditions.description: Stage output JSON validates against the stage's declared output_schema
All required fields defined in the output schema are present and non-null
pass_conditions.check: no required field is missing or null

pass_conditions.description: Output does not contain unstructured free-text where structured fields are expected
pass_conditions.check: output matches Pydantic model without extra unparsed text fields

pass_conditions.description: All enum-typed fields contain values within the declared enumeration

structured_output.failure_behavior: Retry once with validation error context appended to prompt; if retry fails, mark stage as retryable and record failure details

goal.description: Research goal is well-formed with clear question, domain, and constraints
conditions: goal.domain is a recognized domain identifier

evidence.description: Evidence cards reference valid sources with source_id

hypothesis.description: Hypothesis is testable with defined acceptance and stop conditions

experiment.description: Experiment design is pre-registered and executable
conditions: metrics have direction and primary flag

analysis.description: Analysis results are complete and support status is determined
conditions: all metrics computed for all profile-variant combinations
support_status is one of: supported, partially_supported, unsupported, inconclusive
negative results are reported without omission

publish.description: Published payload passes schema validation and sanitization
conditions: no API keys or secrets in payload
all artifact paths are repository-relative or public URLs

jaccard_threshold.description: Top-5 route set Jaccard similarity must be >= 0.6 for all profile-mode-dimension-direction combinations
jaccard_threshold.on_failure: If more than 2 dimensions fail, hypothesis is falsified; stop and enter negative result reporting

spearman_threshold.description: Spearman rank correlation across all 90 routes must be >= 0.85
spearman_threshold.on_failure: Report as negative result; do not omit

constraint_pass_rate_consistency.description: Hard constraint pass rate must not change after weight perturbation; any change indicates perturbation affected constraint logic rather than ranking

minimum_candidates.description: Each profile-mode combination must have at least 5 feasible candidates to form a top-5 set
minimum_candidates.on_failure: Mark combination as insufficient sample; exclude from Jaccard calculation and report honestly

dimension_failure_limit.description: At most 2 of 5 dimensions may have any perturbation causing Jaccard < 0.6; exceeding 2 falsifies the hypothesis
dimension_failure_limit.on_failure: Stop all remaining perturbations; enter negative result reporting

no_shell_injection.description: No user or model input is concatenated into shell command strings
no_shell_injection.check: all subprocess calls use fixed command templates with argument lists

path_boundary.description: All write paths resolve within the repository boundary
path_boundary.check: resolved path starts with repository root

no_sensitive_output.description: No API keys, authorization headers, or full free-text profiles appear in any output file
no_sensitive_output.check: output files pass sensitive pattern scan
